_comment: The crisis resources Medabrain surfaces to a student. This file is served statically and read at runtime by src/lib/safety/resources.js, so the numbers, names and wording can be corrected by editing this one file — no code change, no rebuild of the bundle. Every field is validated on load and anything malformed falls back to the compiled-in defaults in src/lib/safety/resources.js, so a bad edit here degrades to the shipped resources rather than to no resources at all. Country is US-only today because the student body is; add entries rather than replacing them if that changes.
cardTitle: If things are heavy right now
cardBody: You don't have to be in danger to use these. They are free, open 24 hours, and you can text instead of talking.

resources.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988. Free, confidential, 24/7, anywhere in the US.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text HOME to 741741 to reach a trained volunteer counselor, 24/7.

resources.name: The Trevor Project
resources.description: Call 1-866-488-7386 or text START to 678-678 — for LGBTQ young people, 24/7.

resources.name: 911 or your nearest emergency room
resources.description: If you or someone else is in immediate physical danger, this is the fastest help.
